_note: A TAF's own times and whether it speaks for now (the engine's taf_validity): the TAF is FAA-H-8083-28B 27.4.1's own example's header, KPIR issued the 11th at 1130Z for 1112/1212 (valid from the 11th at 12Z to the 12th at 12Z), read in November 2026. A TAF is a forecast for its valid period only: before it, not yet; at its end and after, expired (the same rule as weather_in_force's for a TAF). Times are Unix seconds, UTC. The engine (engine/facade/tests/taf_validity.rs) and the web (features/place/tafValidity.test.ts) are held to it.

cases.why: read before its valid period starts: issued, not yet in force
the first second of its valid period
the end of its valid period: expired
kept on a phone with no signal into the next day: expired
